datePolicy: Retains each original source register entry access/seen date of 2026-11-06 Asia/Singapore (UTC+8); some original retrieval receipts were 2026-11-05 UTC. Localization on 2026-11-06 used finished local evidence only: no external refresh, contact or new availability confirmation. Relative listing update labels remain relative to the seen date, not the reader date.
uncertainties: No fresh self-contained studio price or studio under S$2,000 was established. LC3 S$2,200 is an older comparator only, bills unknown, landlord last active 2026-06-05; not current candidate or availability.

All 15 recent-advertising examples and 3 weaker comparisons are asking terms on the seen date, not vacancy/condition/authority/agent certification or 2027-03-01 offers. Gender unknown; female-only restrictions and contradictory Heritage View labels retained.

L13 says owner not staying; require whole-flat approval and lawful tenancy/room-use structure rather than assume owner-bedroom approval. L3 December date has no year and conflicts with ready-to-move tag. Missing minimum terms, utility caps and bill inclusions remain unknown.

HDB pages often returned navigation only; official indexed snippets were supplemented by full relevant CEA tenant guide and gov.sg explainer. The latter older occupancy footnote is superseded by HDB extension and URA through 2028. HDB extension publication-date discrepancy not used for decisions.

Private and HDB approvals, pass timing, owner residence and occupant limits require case-specific rechecking. No owner, actual room approval, registered advertiser identity, payee or contract has been independently certified.

Station/walking times are advertiser claims or author estimates, not measured door-to-door routes. Listing screens and corridor allowances are not identical calculations. Office walk, waits and advertised shuttle need checking.

Rent targets, utility allowances, monthly spending, medical buffer, setup and reserves are estimates. Own-agent fee and security deposit are commercial conventions, not regulated tariffs; actual agreement and GST can differ. Hotel nights excluded, deposit locked up and recovery not guaranteed.

Illustrative full-year resident tax at S$84,000 and partial March–December 2027 tax at S$70,000 are before reliefs using dated rates. Residence, early departure, future rates, benefits, bonuses and Malaysian tax exposure can change the result; monthly reserve is not payroll withholding.

Gross salary scenario excludes bonus, debts, dependants, remittances and Malaysian taxes. No employee CPF assumes foreign EP status, not citizen or PR. S$2,000 base rent plus bills exceeds a strict S$2,000 all-in ceiling.
editingContract: Complete English and Simplified Chinese reader-first local drafts. Exact numeric/date/currency/external URL multiplicities and corresponding table-cell parity; no Review/stars, public attachment promises, source-run edits, website repo edits, publication or shared integration changes.

audience.en: First-time Singapore renters, illustrated by a Malaysian EP-holder engineer working at one-north; nationality, pass validity and gender-specific room eligibility differ for each renter.
audience.zh: 首次在新加坡租房的人，示例是在 one-north 工作、持 EP 的马来西亚籍工程师；国籍、准证有效期和按性别限定的房间资格因人而异。
